extraordinary_question.question: Could reciprocal system integration alter which distinctions are expressible without altering the underlying source evidence?

taxonomic_levels_analysis.proof: Integrating Rule and Rulefield views allows the system to formulate expressions like Rule(x, c1) and Rulefield(x, c2) about the same referent x. This enriches the linguistic syntax.
Closed-loop feedback between Atelier and Encyclopedia allows constraint violations to be pruned in 1 step rather than through unconstrained exhaustive search, improving algorithmic search efficiency.

taxonomic_levels_analysis.claim: A change in measurable predictive performance
taxonomic_levels_analysis.proof: In source-free synthetic tests, constraint satisfaction rate improved from 50% to 100% on synthetic tasks. However, this is internal benchmark optimization, not external predictive power.
Adjunctions, Grothendieck fibrations, and bisimulation on product lattices already provide exact, complete mathematical models. No new theorem or mathematical entity was created.

taxonomic_levels_analysis.claim: A new independently observed empirical phenomenon
taxonomic_levels_analysis.proof: No independent external physical sensor, detector, or human experiment was executed. All data is synthetic code execution. Claiming physical emergence from internal simulation is strictly prohibited.
